threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground' – that gives you away every time.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last week, had to sidestep a guy trying to start a dance-off in the aisle. Only in South London, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the local Turkish bakery learned my name and started adding extra pastries to my order. That’s when I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a döner at 3 AM, then find a spontaneous open-air techno party in the park. Feels like the city never sleeps.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to give a wide berth to the BART Civic Center station during any whiff of smoke. Tourists just stare, phones in hand.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 19 bus, casually wearing flip-flops. Only in San Francisco do you level up and down at the same time.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the nightlife, but many of us prefer the quiet plazas for our evening chats over cerveses.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new when they still stare in awe at the Güell Park mosaics, taking photos from every angle, while locals just breeze by.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know you're new when you assume every street food stall is a pop-up, not just another Saturday market fixture in Dalston.
Heard a couple arguing over whether the night bus was a good choice; she swore it was safer than a cab. Ended with him ordering an Uber while she scowled.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I found a whole vintage market in an abandoned subway station. They had records, old cameras, and a chess game in full swing. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you see people casually sipping coffee in the middle of a bus stop, completely unfazed by the chaos around them.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows that dodging the BART delays is a daily game; tourists just stare at their phones while the train's stuck in the Tube.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 21 Hayes, practicing his speech for a wedding. Everyone else just acted like it was normal. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve tapas, but many locals hit up la plaça for a 'bocadillo' and a beer before heading home. It's a hidden gem.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by how they always order a cappuccino after noon; locals know that's a giveaway to avoid.
